create_Renderer_instance: create a Renderer instance with width, height, background image, and config path for offscreen rendering
render_object_poses_with_force: render color and depth images from object poses and normal forces with noise and calibration
render_from_depth_map: render color and depth images from a depth map with configurable noise and calibration
add_object_to_scene: add a trimesh object to the rendering scene with a name, position, and orientation
update_camera_pose: update the camera, lighting, and gel surface pose with new position and orientation
